content: {"rule": "K-C", "applies": "yes", "applies_why": "The judge text grades a link (D5 vs C5) against the pressing side's rows and [CR2] G, so it is deciding a chain-against-chain collision under K-C.", "verdict": "CLEAN", "quote": "D5 vs C5 (Isaiah 7:14): UNDERDETERMINED -- [CR2] G answers the 'almah/bethulah and near-fulfillment rows, leaving the sign's sense open.", "rule_words": "When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.", "room": "leaving the sign's sense open: one reading requires a single verse itself to state the sign's sense (the retired stating-verse test); the other reads it as a chain-level finding that the whole support remains underdetermined.", "why": "The judge cites [CR2] G's answer to the rows and finds the sign's sense still open, which is a chain-level underdetermination rather than a verse-by-verse stating-verse test."}
